hooks.command: VERITAS_SESSION_LOG_PATH="${VERITAS_SESSION_LOG_PATH:-${CLAUDE_TRANSCRIPT_PATH:-}}"; if [ -n "$VERITAS_SESSION_LOG_PATH" ]; then VERITAS_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; VERITAS_PREFIX=; VERITAS_FOUND=; VERITAS_DIR="$(pwd -P 2>/dev/null)"; while :; do case "$VERITAS_DIR" in /*) ;; *) break;; esac; if [ -z "$VERITAS_FOUND" ] && [ -f "$VERITAS_DIR/node_modules/@kontourai/veritas/package.json" ]; then VERITAS_FOUND="$VERITAS_DIR"; fi; if [ -n "$VERITAS_ROOT" ] && [ "$VERITAS_DIR" -ef "$VERITAS_ROOT" ]; then VERITAS_PREFIX="$VERITAS_FOUND"; break; fi; if [ "$VERITAS_DIR" = / ]; then break; fi; VERITAS_DIR="${VERITAS_DIR%/*}"; [ -n "$VERITAS_DIR" ] || VERITAS_DIR=/; done; if [ -n "$VERITAS_PREFIX" ]; then npx --no --prefix "$VERITAS_PREFIX" @kontourai/veritas feedback observe --tool claude-code --session-log "$VERITAS_SESSION_LOG_PATH"; else npx --no @kontourai/veritas feedback observe --tool claude-code --session-log "$VERITAS_SESSION_LOG_PATH"; fi; fi
